rules: NEXT_PUBLIC_* values are public and must not contain secrets.
Staging and production are the only deployment targets.
Local execution must use the same variable names as staging with sandbox-only resources.
.dev.vars is local-only and must not contain staging or production credentials.
Provider webhook secrets are never committed.
Worker staging and production secrets live in Cloudflare secret stores, not tracked files.

mobile.secretStore: Mobile CI dart-define and platform secret injection
rules: No provider secret keys in Flutter source.
Only public endpoint and anon client values may be passed to app builds.
Mobile build artifacts and generated platform caches remain ignored.
